intent_signals: New or recently renovated patient tower or campus entrance opening (capital project completion announcement)
Magnet recognition application or re-designation in progress (HCAHPS / Press Ganey scores are strategic priority)
New CEO, COO, or VP Operations hire in trailing 12 months (leadership change drives vendor review)
Published Form 990 showing non-clinical operating-budget growth year-over-year
Community-health investment announcement or community-benefit program launch
Job posting for Director of Facilities or Director of Marketing & Communications (active program build-out)
Active holiday or seasonal community-events programming on public social channels
exclusions: For-profit HCA-owned or Tenet-owned facilities (no local budget authority for facility aesthetics — per handbook)
Hospitals with fewer than 300 beds (insufficient dedicated Facilities + MarCom staff)
Critical Access Hospitals under 100 beds (budget thresholds too small for viable engagement)
Hospitals flagged in active pipeline (defer to sales)
